{{Top|leg}}
'''Variable geometry servo-motors''' were components of some [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], as well as the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]]. The pontoon-like booms of the [[AQ-5 Waveskimmer]], which featured micro-[[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] technology, were based on the technology of the variable geometry servo-motor.
